facts.fact: The deal record puts CAMTEL's existing national fibre at about 12,000 km terrestrial plus about 812 km overhead on electricity poles, as reported on 2026-03-09; it names no regions or towns.

systems.system: Cameroon Fibre Optic Transmission Backbone Extension Phase IV

note: Phase IV is status Pipeline: decree authorises a loan of about US$195M but the loan is not confirmed signed, so not building.
